M-ERRORS.NAME: Error and output contract
M-ERRORS.purpose: Single source of truth for exit codes, typed errors, findings and JSON envelopes (ADR-3, ADR-8).

export-EXIT.PURPOSE: Exit-code constants: 0 ok, 1 findings, 2 usage/config, 3 internal.

type-ExitCode.PURPOSE: Union of the four documented exit codes.

type-Finding.PURPOSE: One machine-readable finding: severity, code, message, file/line, hint.

type-ResultEnvelope.PURPOSE: Stable JSON envelope: ok, exitCode, data, findings, error, meta.

type-MyGraceError.PURPOSE: Base typed error carrying code, exitCode, hint and location.

type-ProjectNotFoundError.PURPOSE: No docs/graph-index.xml above the working directory (exit 2).

type-XmlError.PURPOSE: Malformed project XML, reported as a finding (exit 1).

type-TrustError.PURPOSE: Project command refused without a valid trust record (exit 2).

fn-finding.PURPOSE: Build a Finding with a stable code and optional location/hint.

fn-exitCodeForFindings.PURPOSE: Map findings plus --strict to the documented exit code.

contract.purpose: Single source of truth for exit codes, typed errors, findings and JSON envelopes (ADR-3, ADR-8).

param.name: error
param.description: Any thrown value; typed errors are detected with isMyGraceError.

param.name: exitCode
param.description: Process exit code the caller should use.

error.description: Command refused by the trust gate.

notes.note-1: No filesystem access: purely formatting/printing helpers, so it is safe to import from every layer.
notes.note-2: Finding codes are stable identifiers and are never translated; agents and CI grep for them.
notes.note-3: Text and JSON modes share the same exit-code decision, which is what makes ADR-3 verifiable.
